test_chat_completion: test the Llama3 chat completion module by running pytest on test_chat_completion.py
encode_header_llama3: encode a chat message header using Llama3 special tokens like start_header_id and end_header_id
encode_message_llama3: encode a full chat message with header, content, and eot_id tokens for Llama3
format_dialog_llama3: format a dialog into Llama3 tokens with begin_of_text and default system prompt prepended
format_tokens_llama3: format multiple dialogs into token lists using Llama3 special tokens and system prompt
